detail.title: Hypothesis Formulation: Path-Dependent Preference Formation
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates hypothesis formulation for the project regarding path-dependent preference formation in memory-augmented reinforcement learning agents. A formal hypothesis is proposed to test whether memory architecture induces divergence in agent behavior based on interaction history, despite identical objectives.
